# zig-crypto -- Complete API Reference

> Portable cryptographic primitives in Zig with C FFI -- SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-256, AES-CBC, PBKDF2, ECDH P-256, Ed25519, and CSPRNG. No OpenSSL. No system dependencies.

Part of the [Tinyland Zig Libraries](https://libs.tinyland.dev). License: Zlib OR MIT.

## Installation

```
zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-crypto.git
```

Then in build.zig:

```zig
const dep = b.dependency("zig-crypto", .{ .target = target, .optimize = optimize });
exe.root_module.addImport("zig-crypto", dep.module("zig-crypto"));
```

Or as a git submodule for C FFI consumers:

```
git submodule add https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-crypto.git vendor/crypto
cd vendor/crypto && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
```

Link `-lzig-crypto`. Include `#include "zig_crypto.h"`.

## Source Structure

- `src/ffi.zig` - C FFI exports (19 functions)
- `src/sha256.zig` - SHA-256 hash (single-shot and incremental)
- `src/hmac.zig` - HMAC-SHA-256
- `src/aes.zig` - AES-128/256-CBC (PKCS#7 and raw modes)
- `src/pbkdf2.zig` - PBKDF2-SHA1 key derivation
- `src/ecdh.zig` - ECDH P-256 key agreement
- `src/ed25519.zig` - Ed25519 digital signatures
- `src/random.zig` - OS-backed CSPRNG
- `include/zig_crypto.h` - C header (19 functions + size constants)
- `tests/pbt_*.zig` - Property-based tests (1000-iteration roundtrips)
- `examples/hash_and_sign.c` - C usage example

## C API Reference (zig_crypto.h)

All functions are thread-safe and stateless. Buffers are caller-provided.

### Size Constants

- `ZIG_CRYPTO_SHA256_DIGEST_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_SHA256_BLOCK_LEN` = 64
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_HMAC_SHA256_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_AES_BLOCK_LEN` = 16
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_P256_SCALAR_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_P256_COORD_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_ED25519_SEED_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_ED25519_PUBLIC_LEN` = 32
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_ED25519_SIGNING_LEN` = 64
- `ZIG_CRYPTO_ED25519_SIGNATURE_LEN` = 64

### SHA-256

- `void zig_crypto_sha256(const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t *out)`: Compute SHA-256 hash. out must be at least 32 bytes.
- `size_t zig_crypto_sha256_hex(const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t *out)`: Compute SHA-256 and write lowercase hex string. out must be at least 64 bytes. Returns 64.

### HMAC-SHA-256

- `void zig_crypto_hmac_sha256(const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t *out)`: Compute HMAC-SHA-256. out must be at least 32 bytes.

### AES-128-CBC

- `int zig_crypto_aes128_cbc_encrypt(const uint8_t key[16], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *plaintext, size_t plaintext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Encrypt with PKCS#7 padding. out must have room for plaintext_len + 16 bytes. Returns ciphertext length or -1.
- `int zig_crypto_aes128_cbc_decrypt(const uint8_t key[16], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *ciphertext, size_t ciphertext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Decrypt with PKCS#7 unpadding. Returns plaintext length or -1.

### AES-256-CBC

- `int zig_crypto_aes256_cbc_encrypt(const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *plaintext, size_t plaintext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Encrypt with PKCS#7 padding. Returns ciphertext length or -1.
- `int zig_crypto_aes256_cbc_decrypt(const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *ciphertext, size_t ciphertext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Decrypt with PKCS#7 unpadding. Returns plaintext length or -1.
- `int zig_crypto_aes256_cbc_encrypt_raw(const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *plaintext, size_t plaintext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Encrypt without padding (raw blocks). plaintext_len must be a multiple of 16. For CTAP2 PIN protocol.
- `int zig_crypto_aes256_cbc_decrypt_raw(const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t iv[16], const uint8_t *ciphertext, size_t ciphertext_len, uint8_t *out)`: Decrypt without unpadding (raw blocks). ciphertext_len must be a multiple of 16. For CTAP2 PIN protocol.

### PBKDF2-SHA1

- `void zig_crypto_pbkdf2_sha1(const uint8_t *passphrase, size_t passphrase_len, const uint8_t *salt, size_t salt_len, uint32_t iterations, uint8_t *out, size_t out_len)`: RFC 6070 PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA1. Derives out_len bytes of key material.

### ECDH P-256

- `int zig_crypto_p256_generate(uint8_t *out_scalar, uint8_t *out_pub_x, uint8_t *out_pub_y)`: Generate ephemeral P-256 key pair. Writes 32 bytes each. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
- `int zig_crypto_p256_ecdh(const uint8_t scalar[32], const uint8_t peer_x[32], const uint8_t peer_y[32], uint8_t *out_shared_secret)`: ECDH shared secret: SHA-256(x-coordinate of scalar * peer_point). Writes 32 bytes. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure. Matches CTAP2 PIN protocol v2 shared secret derivation.

### Ed25519

- `void zig_crypto_ed25519_generate(uint8_t *out_seed, uint8_t *out_public, uint8_t *out_signing)`: Generate random Ed25519 key pair. Writes seed(32), public(32), signing_key(64).
- `int zig_crypto_ed25519_from_seed(const uint8_t seed[32], uint8_t *out_public, uint8_t *out_signing)`: Derive key pair from 32-byte seed (deterministic). Writes public(32), signing_key(64). Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
- `int zig_crypto_ed25519_sign(const uint8_t *message, size_t message_len, const uint8_t signing_key[64], uint8_t *out_signature)`: Sign a message. Writes 64-byte signature. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
- `bool zig_crypto_ed25519_verify(const uint8_t *message, size_t message_len, const uint8_t signature[64], const uint8_t public_key[32])`: Verify an Ed25519 signature. Returns true if valid.

### CSPRNG

- `bool zig_crypto_random(uint8_t *buf, size_t len)`: Fill buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes. Uses getrandom (Linux) or getentropy (macOS). Returns true on success, false on failure.

## Zig API Reference

### sha256.zig
- `hash(data: []const u8) -> [32]u8`: Single-shot SHA-256 hash.
- `Hasher`: Incremental hasher. Methods: `init() -> Hasher`, `update(data)`, `final() -> [32]u8`.

### hmac.zig
- `hmacSha256(key: []const u8, data: []const u8) -> [32]u8`: Compute HMAC-SHA-256.

### aes.zig
- `cbc128Encrypt(key, iv, plaintext, out) -> !usize`: AES-128-CBC encrypt with PKCS#7 padding.
- `cbc128Decrypt(key, iv, ciphertext, out) -> !usize`: AES-128-CBC decrypt with PKCS#7 unpadding.
- `cbc256Encrypt(key, iv, plaintext, out) -> !usize`: AES-256-CBC encrypt with PKCS#7 padding.
- `cbc256Decrypt(key, iv, ciphertext, out) -> !usize`: AES-256-CBC decrypt with PKCS#7 unpadding.
- `cbc256EncryptRaw(key, iv, plaintext, out) -> !usize`: AES-256-CBC encrypt without padding. Input must be multiple of 16.
- `cbc256DecryptRaw(key, iv, ciphertext, out) -> !usize`: AES-256-CBC decrypt without unpadding. Input must be multiple of 16.

### pbkdf2.zig
- `pbkdf2Sha1(passphrase, salt, iterations, out)`: PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA1. Derives `out.len` bytes.

### ecdh.zig
- `KeyPair`: Struct with `scalar: [32]u8`, `public_x: [32]u8`, `public_y: [32]u8`.
- `generateKeyPair() -> !KeyPair`: Generate ephemeral P-256 key pair.
- `deriveSharedSecret(scalar, peer_x, peer_y) -> ![32]u8`: ECDH: SHA-256(x-coordinate of d * Q).

### ed25519.zig
- `KeyPair`: Struct with `seed: [32]u8`, `public_key: [32]u8`, `signing_key: [64]u8`.
- `generateKeyPair() -> KeyPair`: Generate from random seed.
- `fromSeed(seed) -> !KeyPair`: Derive from 32-byte seed (deterministic).
- `sign(message, signing_key) -> ![64]u8`: Sign a message.
- `verify(message, signature, public_key) -> bool`: Verify a signature.

### random.zig
- `fill(buf: []u8) -> !void`: Fill with OS-provided CSPRNG bytes.

## Error Convention

- Functions returning `int`: 0 on success, -1 on failure. Data-length returns use byte count on success, negative on error.
- Functions returning `bool`: true on success, false on failure.
- Zig API uses error unions (`!T`).

## Build

```
zig build                        # static library
zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast # optimized build
zig build test                   # unit tests
zig build test-pbt               # property-based tests (1000 iterations)
zig build docs                   # generate API docs
```

## Platform Support

Cross-platform. Pure Zig `std.crypto`, no system crypto dependencies. Tested on macOS (arm64/x86_64) and Linux (x86_64/arm64).
